elements_selected.content: Implement parse_protocol(sexpr) -> Result<CausalProtocol, ProtocolParseError> in cbcl-parser. Parse (protocol (then ...)+) with (any ...) and (all ...) node-refs. Desugar variadic (then a b c) to pairwise edges. REQ-201 grammar. New file: crates/cbcl-parser/src/protocol_parser.rs. Also integrate into dialect_parser.rs: when a (protocol ...) clause is encountered during dialect parsing, dispatch to parse_protocol.
